summary: Frontend-only test of the 'session ended -> number prefilled + short note' login fix and lint clean-up (web preview 390x844 + 320x700, QA learner 7004186276, 8 sign-ins total, spread so no more than 7 fell in any 15-minute window, so the rate limit was never hit). All 11 requested scenarios PASS: (1) sign-in -> Home, jl_last_phone='"7004186276"'; (2) server logout + reload -> entry-session-expired 'Aapka session khatam ho gaya. Number pehle se bhara hai...', phone prefilled, entry-remembered-phone + 'Doosra number?', PIN input focused (typing via keyboard went straight into PIN), PIN -> Home, jl_session_ended removed; (3) note + number survive 2 reloads (cold start with jl_user gone); (4) 401 path: My Tests -> killed session -> Rank -> My Tests: /auth/refresh 401 -> app lands on /entry with note, number and PIN focus; (5) jl_last_phone removed + kill + reload -> number taken from saved profile as 7004186276; (9) Forgot PIN prefilled with 7004186276 (not submitted); (6) Doosra number? -> field empty, row gone, jl_last_phone removed, note switches to 'Number aur PIN daal kar wapas aao...', stays empty after reload; (7) explicit sign out -> no note, empty field, jl_last_phone/jl_session_ended absent (also after reload); (8) fresh context -> no note, empty field; (10) 320x700: scrollWidth=clientWidth=320, note/row/buttons inside 16..304, Doosra number? 114x44, Forgot PIN? 89x44; (11) Rapid Fire lobby/Gang/Trophy open, no page errors, 0 extra API calls while sitting on Gang/Trophy for 5 s (no useFocusEffect loop); catalogue search sends q= to API, shows empty state for no match, clear works, and the typed search is kept when going back to the exam hub and opening the section again. expo lint: 0 warnings. tsc --noEmit: clean. No page errors in any run.

issues: After going to Forgot PIN and coming back (forgot-pin-back), the PIN input is no longer focused. The focus effect in app/entry.tsx:35 only runs again when expired/remembered/signup change. Small UX point, not a blocker.
catalogue-clear-search is an 18px icon in a Press with no hitSlop or minimum size. The tap target is well under 44px (app/catalogue.tsx:111). This was there before this change.

action_items: Optional: focus the PIN input again when entry gets focus back while expired && remembered (for example inside the existing useFocusEffect).
Optional: give catalogue-clear-search hitSlop or minWidth/minHeight 44.
critical_code_review_comments: app/catalogue.tsx:81: the catalogue only saves the debounced `query` (300 ms) in `remembered`, not `q`. If a student types and leaves within 300 ms, the text they just typed is lost. Minor.

Catalogue filtering could not be checked against real rows: JEE Main chapter-wise (Physics) and the AITS section have 0 live papers. I verified the request (q=...), the empty state, clear, and that the search is kept.
No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) in package.json. No SafeAreaView import from react-native.
seed_data_creation: None. Only sign-in, sign-out and server logout on the QA learner. No test paper was started, answered or submitted, and nothing was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simulate a server-side session end with fetch(location.origin+'/api/jl/auth/logout',{method:'POST',headers:{'X-JL-Sid':JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('jl_sid')),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:'{}'}). Login is limited to 8 per number per 15 min, so wait about 15 min between batches. Rapid Fire arena-tab-home goes back to the app Home. Home tile testID: home-tile-jee-main; exam hub rows: exam-destination-{pyq,aits,history}. pyq goes to /pyq, not the catalogue.
